scope: Composite state, graph, comprehensive-status, and strategic-reserve reports

behavior.section_failures: Report sections expose only a bounded operation and exception-class summary.
behavior.graph_failures: Graph report output and console warning omit raw descriptor exceptions.
behavior.resilience: Per-section continuation and partial-report output are preserved.

coverage: state-of-Kokonut section exception redaction and cursor cleanup
graph descriptor exception redaction from report and console output

static_checks.database_or_provider_access: none; fake connection and generator functions

limitations: No report calculation or database service was run.
This does not establish report parity against populated legacy fixtures.
